title: lattice: refactor quality logic
description: Refactor src/lattice/quality.rs to implement the QualityEvaluator trait and use unified domain types. Ensure logic is purely functional.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL perform quality analysis using side-effect-free logic.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return a domain::QualityReport.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT crash the application

invariants: The calculation produces deterministic results for identical inputs

title: lattice: pure ears parsing
description: Refactor lattice/ears.rs to be side-effect-free and independent of intent modules.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL parse EARS patterns from raw text into structured requirements.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL identify ubiquitous, event-driven, and unwanted patterns.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT halt processing
unwanted.because: partial parsing is better than failure.

preconditions: Input is a valid UTF-8 string
postconditions: Output is a Vec of parsed requirements
invariants: Parsing never modifies the input string

phase_1: Refactor regex logic into pure functions

title: lattice: consolidate causal patterns
description: Merge duplicate dependency and effect tracing logic from intent/quality/effects.rs into lattice/effects.rs.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain a single library of causal patterns.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL use the unified lattice::effects module.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow both versions to coexist

invariants: The unified module supports all existing pattern matches
